T: Cream puffs at the palace. Rum after.
D: Jack Sparrow is forced aboard Blackbeard's ship on a race to the Fountain of Youth.
P: Serve dessert when Jack helps himself to the cream puffs at King George's palace.
S: Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on crushed ice with a cocktail sauce.
London tavern beef and gravy pies
the London tavern where Jack finds Angelica

Mini beef pies of mince and gravy in shortcrust with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, 300ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tbsp tomato paste and simmer 20 minutes until thick, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with the mince, top with rounds cut from 2 sheets puff pastry, crimp and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
the Spanish fleet racing for the Fountain
Green and black olives marinated with orange peel, garlic, chilli and olive oil, with manchego.
M: the Spanish are racing for the fountain too

Saffron rice with chicken, chorizo, prawns and mussels, cooked in one wide pan and left alone so the rice on the bottom turns crisp. Brown 400g chicken thighs and 1 sliced chorizo, add an onion and capsicum, then 300g paella rice, saffron, paprika and 900ml stock. Simmer 15 minutes without stirring, add 300g prawns and 500g mussels and cook 6 minutes more.
the jungle island with the Fountain of Youth

Pork shoulder rubbed with jerk spices, slow cooked at 150C for 4 hours, pulled with rice and beans. Blitz 4 spring onions, 2 scotch bonnet or red chillies, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp allspice, 1 tbsp thyme leaves, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 tbsp soy and the juice of 2 limes into a paste. Rub over a 1.5kg pork shoulder and marinate overnight. Roast covered at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart, then shred with the juices. Simmer 1.5 cups rice with a tin of drained kidney beans, 400ml coconut milk and water for 18 minutes and serve together.
W: Jack eating the cream puffs at the palace
Choux pastry baked at 200C until puffed, filled with vanilla custard cream and dusted with icing sugar.
K: the waters of the Fountain of Youth

White rum, coconut water, pineapple and lime shaken with a little sugar syrup, poured over crushed ice and grated with nutmeg. Mix 160ml white rum, 400ml coconut water, 300ml pineapple juice, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar syrup in a jug and stir well. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the punch and grate a little fresh nutmeg over the top. Add a pineapple wedge. For a non-drinking version, leave out the rum and add an extra 150ml coconut water.

s.how: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach 2 minutes, then plunge into iced water. Peel and serve on crushed ice with mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce and hot sauce.

s.note: the Spanish fleet racing for the Fountain
s.how: Toss 150g green olives and 150g kalamata olives with strips of orange peel, sliced garlic, a pinch of chilli and olive oil. Leave for an hour. Serve with thin wedges of manchego for a Spanish galleon crew.

w.note: Jack eating the cream puffs at the palace
w.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe small mounds and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Fold whipped cream into custard, fill each puff and dust with icing sugar. Royal treats.
